key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the vivid footprint idiom, promise, descendants, and childlessness.
key_decisions.before: Yet God gave him no inheritance in it, not even enough to set his foot on, but promised to give it to him as a possession and to his offspring after him, even though Abraham had no child.
key_decisions.after: God gave him no inheritance in it—not even enough ground to set his foot on—but promised to give it to him as a possession and to his descendants after him, though Abraham had no child.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Yet he gave him no inheritance in it, not even a foot’s length, but promised to give it to him as a possession and to his offspring after him, though he had no child.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves foreign residence, enslavement, harm, and exact duration.
key_decisions.before: God spoke in this way: ‘His offspring will live as foreigners in a land belonging to others. They will enslave and mistreat them for four hundred years.
key_decisions.after: God spoke of it this way: ‘His descendants will live as strangers in a foreign land, and its people will enslave and mistreat them for four hundred years.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And God spoke to this effect—that his offspring would be sojourners in a land belonging to others, who would enslave them and afflict them four hundred years.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps divine judgment, exodus, and worship destination.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves covenant, genealogy, and eighth-day timing.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains divine seeing, hearing, descent, rescue, and commission.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the rejection-and-commission reversal and the title redeemer.

key_decisions.tsw_comparator: “This Moses, whom they rejected, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—this man God sent as both ruler and redeemer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
